encode_context_and_table: encode context text and table columns into BERT representations using input tensors and column masks
get_column_representation: aggregate column token encodings into column-level representations using mean pool, max pool, or first token
to_tensor_dict: convert a list of context strings and Table objects into batched PyTorch tensors for model input
encode: encode context and table pairs into context and column embeddings with optional BERT encoding output
validate: run masked language model validation on a data loader and return perplexity statistics
